dialogue.patient: I feel sick — like I'm going to throw up, the whole time. And my chest.
My chest hurts. Low down in the middle, the right side, across both sides of my chest, and down here at the pit of my stomach.
Heavy, like something's sitting on me — and stabbing at the same time. It makes me feel sick. It's frightening.
It goes down both arms. Up to my throat here. Both shoulders too.
Six out of ten. I can't tell you exactly where it is — it's spread out.
It came on fast. Very fast.
I can't get a full breath in.
I'm diabetic. High cholesterol, high blood pressure too. They said my circulation isn't good.
I just got back from America.
I'm eating fine, sleeping fine. I'm not sweating more than usual.
